d: Unexpected circumstances lead Danielle's sister and brother-in-law to ask her to take on an environmentally-friendly build of their lake house. Can Danielle reconcile her family's tight timelines and champagne tastes with a tight budget?
Contestants are tested on the world of vintage fashion and designer labels that lead to a valuable vintage find.

Follow the expert duo to visit a garbage man who's spent 40 years building his collection. The guys find treasure in his stash including a heap of vintage pop signs. Marty has his eye on a vintage $12,000 car.

Go not-quite-full-circle with Paul, who gets a chance to inject his signature style into Darren and Delaine's pie-shaped lot. Follow the crew from design to done, as they create a family entertaining space with an upmarket amphitheatre feel.

Cozy up in Brian and Alison's great room, where a new central stone fireplace and a suspended vintage canoe bring lakeside living home. Then dig in at a special breakfast bar Paul has built for his foreman, Jimmy, who's recovering from a stroke.

Pull up a chair as two star bakers whip up purrfect birthday cakes starring a junior designer's feline BFF. Watch the competitors do their best to fulfill the birthday boy's vision of his beloved cat, Gnocchi, battling a city full of people.

Take a shot at guessing which of the star bakers will make a winning goal. See who scores big with their interpretation of an 11-year-old's hockey-themed birthday cake design, complete with a sculpted player, a scoreboard, and a working goal light.

Hit a high note as the star bakers take on a seven-year-old's sweet design. Watch them battle with buttercream and butterflies to create the ultimate celebration cake, then see who is right on tune and who is a little flat.
Steve, Stormy, and Lindsay must make donuts with a “Tailgate Party” theme using mystery ingredients to win $10,000 and impress the judges.
Robert, Carrie, and Josie must create three carnival-themed donuts with mystery ingredients to win $10,000.
Grant, Michelle, and Trista compete to make three Great Canadian Donut-themed donuts and impress the judges to win $10,000.

Navigate a post-nuptial disaster with Tina and Jeff, who had to fork over their honeymoon fund to fix a hot water heater and other unwelcome surprises in their new home. Warm up to Mike and Damon's solutions, which give this family a fresh start.

Head out on the hunt for investment properties with Mike and MJ, then discover a surprise that tests their father-son relationship and their business partnership. Stand back as the sparks fly and Mike gets a lesson in treating his son as an equal.

Duck behind the camera and into the editing suite for a look at how each episode of the show is made. Go location scouting, check out planning meetings, and see the crew gear up and film hours of footage that audiences don't usually get to see.

Hold on as the heat and frantic pace take a toll on Mike and the team. Feel spirits rise as the roof goes up to shield them from the rain, but relive the pain as hurricane survivors turned project volunteers are haunted by memories of Katrina's fury.

Hold your nose in Gina's basement, which was flooded with sewer water during an epic Toronto downpour. Learn how her remediation team botched the cleanup, putting her family and her father's memory-filled basement workshop in jeopardy.

Take a trip to the city in Kevin and Kristen's suburban bungalow, where Paul adds steel and glass accents, a palatial kitchen, and a dining area with a backlit skyline. Then get misty as Paul completes a sweet antique radio makeover for his own dad.

Navigate Boedhi and Ferlin's tiny ensuite, which comes to life when Paul rejigs the layout and adds a glass etching, a deep tub, and Indonesian flair. Then watch fallen trees become the foundation of Joseph and Candida's stunning kitchen island bar.

Take a shortcut to success when Colin whips up a quick, lightweight, removable metal pole dock for a busy family of five. Discover how this simple, one-day project revamps dock life for parents Bryan and Michelle and their three young sons.

Watch your step as Colin reworks a rickety riverside dock that's already sent two people to the hospital. Observe the project, from demolition to final product, and learn the advantages of using rotproof recycled plastic lumber instead of wood.

In this episode Andrew is in Denver… and the collections are massive. He's stunned by a building devoted entirely to Nash cars and nearly speechless over record-setting video game memorabilia and vintage.
In this episode Andrew is in Denver… and is blown away by a collection of vintage coin operated games and jukeboxes.

Drop in at a small town garage filled with 60 years' worth of vintage valuables that Marty and Bam Bam can't get enough of. Then pay an end-of-the-season visit to one of their favourite collectors, who shows them some of her new discoveries.

Say goodbye to urban life as James, Cristina, and their kids trade city lights for lakeside nights. Consider an open concept property made for outdoor entertaining, a mod house with a swim-up bar, and a heritage home with a cobblestone drive.

Take off on a house-hunting adventure with world travellers Diana and Laith, who want their own unique destination beside a lake. Check out a chef-ready log home; a classic place with a luxe wine cellar; and an open-concept marvel with ample storage.

Audition options with Curtis and Emma, who want a lakefront haven where his banking clients and her dance students can mingle. See if a modern canalside spot, a home with a cool cabana, or a house with a two-sided fireplace gets their toes tapping.

Consolidate with Rick and Kerri, who want to swap their principal and vacation homes for one big forever lake house. Soar in an open concept treehouse, get wowed by a double-trouble traditional, and view an impeccable home built into an escarpment.

Drink in the possibilities with wine pros Ken and Georgia, who are ready to cash in on the fruits of their labour. Tour a gourmet French-style house, a manse with plenty of space for a grand piano, and a luxe cliffside home with million-dollar views.

Get pumped as Amanda and Joe look for a lakeside fitness oasis. Investigate a waterfront lavender farm with a separate workout area, a French manor with a lofty exercise zone, and a mod home with a shed that can become this couple's dream gym.

Contend with all the surprises Eiman and Benafsha are encountering after agreeing to their home seller's no-inspection clause. Learn how to spot red flags as Mike shows this duo how much they could have known before signing on the dotted line.

Celebrate when things start looking up at the Country House, where a partial second storey is going up. Then take stock at the River House, where dangerous structural issues force Mike and MJ's crew to take down the roof and the second-floor walls.

Cheer as Mike KO's a botched kitchen reno for Canadian boxing superstar George (Boom Boom) Chuvalo. See a contractor's terrible work, including wonky electrical and missing counters, go down for the count as the team builds a chic, safe family hub.

Look up, way up, as Henry and Mandy show off the many problems with their new-build home. Check out the icy guest room above the garage, which is way too cold to sleep in, then warm up to Mike's simple and satisfying fix for this crummy construction.

Learn why hiring a family friend as a contractor isn't a great idea. Check out the bowed, cracked, badly patched wall in Lynda and Joe's basement walkout that's straining their friendship, then see Mike's team rip it out and get the job done right.

Tread carefully as Mike assesses Benny and Queenie's second-storey deck, which started to fall apart the second they set foot on it. Learn why this mess wasn't built to code and what Mike plans to do to make it right for the tapped-out couple.

Take a trip to the city in Kevin and Kristen's suburban bungalow, where Paul adds steel and glass accents, a palatial kitchen, and a dining area with a backlit skyline. Then get misty as Paul completes a sweet antique radio makeover for his own dad.

Navigate Boedhi and Ferlin's tiny ensuite, which comes to life when Paul rejigs the layout and adds a glass etching, a deep tub, and Indonesian flair. Then watch fallen trees become the foundation of Joseph and Candida's stunning kitchen island bar.

While traveling the backroads the boys spot an entire field of cars and come across a warehouse full of treasure (with a surprise ending). Bam Bam makes an offer on a pick-up truck.

Arielle and Brett ask Lynzie to create a wedding that feels like a massive dance party; with a crazy double-decker room flip involved, Lynzie and her team turn an old historic music hall into a glittery and dreamy floral disco.

Lean into Isabel and Garry's vision of an art-show wedding, which includes cool, custom-built installations. Cheer as Lynzie and her team tackle one of the largest DIY projects they have ever taken on, creating a funky, colourful celebration.

Get a taste of lakeside living and meet three architects who have gone the extra mile to construct their dream homes on the water. Set sail with Colin and Justin as they visit two unique island hideaways and one impressive boat-access-only home.

Travel through time as Colin and Justin explore architecture across the generations. Discover a design that perfectly preserves an old family-built cabin, explore NHL star Wendel Clark's modern retreat, and catch a glimpse of a futuristic getaway.

Stock up on the ultimate souvenirs. Tour a rentable gallery where all the art on the walls is for sale, meet a flock of chickens that lay eggs for the guests at a historic farmhouse, and visit a former bakery that caters to baked-goods enthusiasts.

Unexpected circumstances lead Danielle's sister and brother-in-law to ask her to take on an environmentally-friendly build of their lake house. Can Danielle reconcile her family's tight timelines and champagne tastes with a tight budget?

Drink in the disappointment when Ross and Lisa realize that the home inspection they paid for with a case of beer isn't up to snuff. Discover the deal-breaker the inspector should have noticed in the attic and watch Mike and the crew make it right.

Check out Mike's new prospect: a live-work-play retreat in a tourist area that seems like a smart buy. Learn why MJ's not so keen on the commute to this diamond in the rough, and watch in horror as water issues dry up the budget at the Country House.

Examine the dangerous mess a contractor created when he moved a crucial support in Julie and Joe's attic. Stand back as the Holmes team tears off the entire roof and constructs a safe, well-supported new room for the couple's soon-to-arrive child.

Feel the squeeze as tradespeople jostle to complete a long list of tasks, including electrical, plumbing, and finish carpentry. Look beneath the chaos to see incredible coordination at work and learn about local wetlands preservation with Mike.

Delve into a nasty case of fraud committed by a contractor-friend of Janice and George, who promised them $100K in renos in return for a $300K investment in his business. Learn how to spot red flags as Mike restores the couple's home and their faith.

Lace up for a special reno as Paul finally gives his wife, Janna, the dream kitchen she's always wanted, complete with a desk area where she can work. Then see Sarah and Mike's son Liam get a space-themed bedroom suite that's out of this world.

Soak up the tired '60s vibe of Jeff and Allyson's single bathroom, which doesn't fit their heritage home's aesthetic at all. See Paul bring it in line with mod fixtures, exposed brick, a soaker tub, and a vanity hand-built from salvaged barn beams.

Dive headfirst into a refreshing reno with Paul, as he upgrades the snoozy concrete patio surrounding Anita and Ken's pool. Catch the sound of falling water and wander between the two linked decks, which offer plenty of room for eating and lounging.

Get a lesson in balancing beauty and function in Ileana and Lawrence's urban backyard. Take in Paul's high-end design, including an upper deck with a massive grill set into a marble countertop and a lower lounge area made for imaginative play.
Burning rubber, fast cars and pit crews in action have race car fanatics dreaming about the ultimate mystery prize.
Military vehicles and valuable war artefacts surround two collectors as they search for missing clues in a military museum.
Ride along with Marty and Bam Bam as they hit the jackpot finding creepy dolls, a teenage auctioneer, and a gold finger. Yes, a gold finger!

Hit the road with a pair of jet-setters who enjoy the finer things in life. Peek inside a contemporary home with high-end amenities, a house with an eye-popping fireplace feature, and a rustic getaway with a chef's kitchen and a sports court.

Take stock with recent retirees Irv and Sheryl, who want a well-appointed, grandkid-friendly hideaway. Explore a magnificent home with a gourmet kitchen, a peninsula property with killer views, and a modern custom build on multiple tiers of land.

Look for harmony with Krystal and Josh, two music producers in search of a peaceful place to compose and raise their child. Check out an island retreat; a sleek, terraced beachside property; and a timber-ceilinged home with a unique wine feature.

Take flight with June and Patrick, who need space for their big blended family and June's float plane. See a stunning property with a games room, a timber house with a pro-level sports court, and a home with two-storey windows and a supersize dock.

Clock in with dancer Melanie and business pro Dennis, who are in the market for a live-work space with a man cave. Explore a modern, open home with a lower-level gym, a massive house on rocky terrain, and a contemporary oasis with a private theatre.

Prep for the future with Jordan and Aurelio, who want a lakefront home where they can grow their family. Size up a house with a floor-to-ceiling fireplace, a rustic stunner with a hot tub and an extended dock, and a loft-equipped timber home.

Steel yourself as Mike identifies all the problems Anna and Terry still need to fix after spending their savings on the things their home inspector caught. Check in with Damon and crew, who lean into a big porch repair and a backyard update.

Confront a huge setback that derails the River House budget and schedule, then watch the rest of the home come down to make way for a rebuild. Later, check out a cool garage workshop and fixes for a tricky water issue plaguing the Country House.

Total up the costly repairs Lisa's income property is in for after her seemingly perfect tenants were busted for running an illegal grow op. Investigate the extensive damage as Mike rehabs the home and helps rescue the owner's retirement investment.

Prepare for new beginnings as homeowner Pat turns the windfall from a nine-year-long lawsuit against her home inspector into some much-needed improvements around her house. Strap in as Mike builds a two-storey backyard deck to improve her outlook.

Take this fix one step at a time as Debbie and Ross detail the problems they've had with the open-concept staircase their contractor made from particleboard and cheap spindles. Cheer as Mike rips it out and builds them a stairway to heaven.

Join firefighters, volunteers, and city workers as they help Mike rebuild the beloved castle playground in Toronto's High Park after arson levels it. Cheer as they fight extreme heat to create an imaginative new structure worthy of tiny royalty.

Bam Bam has his pockets full as he and Marty hit the road. Get your hands dirty as the boys end up at a recycling plant digging for deals and pop culture items that include a vintage Asteroids arcade game and a 1964 Beatles mug.

Check out the smelly, icy kitchen addition that's worrying Neil and Michelle in their first house. Examine its maxed-out electrical circuits with Mike, who chases down the cause of this room's issues so the crew can turn it into a warm, safe space.

Rally around a teacher injured in a hit and run and see Mike's crew band together to make his backyard deck accessible while he learns to walk again. Explore their custom healing oasis and enjoy a knockout visit with boxing legend George Chuvalo.

Get shaken when Mike and MJ discover a new budget- and schedule-killing issue with the Country House barn. See what designer Sarah Richardson says about the Holmes duo's flooring debate, then celebrate a new beginning when MJ and Lisa tie the knot.

Check out Dave and Melanie's $38,000 bust: a kitchen addition and deck that failed a city inspection. See what Mike and his team propose to redeem this reno after the stucco starts to crumble and the contractor stops returning the couple's calls.

Rush to the rescue of the Alpha Omicron Pi sorority house, where a leak is putting the kibosh on the Greek-life good times. Join Mike as he supervises the installation of a brand new flat roof, complete with a safe, party-ready rooftop deck.

Take a spin through David and San Yee's house, which was deemed A-okay by a home inspector. Listen in as Mike hears the owners' concerns about a potential health hazard they've found and see how the crew makes this house safe for their small family.

Sift through the damage in Peggy and Don's house, where a contractor's neglect left them wide open to heavy rains. Watch Mike's team redesign and reinforce the home after banishing mould, dry rot, and the biggest nest of ants Mike's ever seen.

Drill down on Jeremy's kitchen reno with Mike and find nothing but cosmetic fixes on top of a host of old problems. Watch the crew take it back to the studs, upgrade the underlying systems, and deliver a gorgeous space built on solid foundations.
Alex dreams of a giant donut birthday cake! Umie and Adjoa battle to turn her sweet obsession into a gravity-defying dessert.
Derek, Rachelle, and Nate must make donuts with a “Love” theme and impress the judges to take home the $10,000 grand prize.

Plunge into the hunt for a waterfront property where Bruce and Darka can spend their retirement pursuing their passion for sports and for entertaining. Check out a scuba-friendly oasis, a sumptuous estate, and a modern new home with a rooftop pool.

Explore the options for Ken and Sarah, newlyweds who can't afford to buy in the city. They want a place where they can entertain on special occasions and then rent out while they continue to live in their city home.

Celebrate the virtues of a beloved building material and learn why wood is the gold standard for many architects. Check out how this natural resource takes a Japanese-inspired home, a restored lodge, and a timber-clad cabin to the next level.
Two shoe fanatics go head-to-head in tests of knowledge and skill.

It's a world of adventure for Bam Bam and Marty as they experience a taste of Germany and head back to school where they get a lesson in negotiating. Later, follow the backroads out to a sea of abandoned boats where surprising deals are made.

Check back in on Peggy and Don's rebuild, which was just inches away from being a complete demo. Go down Mike's extensive checklist, which has already cost $144K, and stand back as he calls in reinforcements to help get the job done right.

Navigate through the rubble of two terrible unfinished renos that left Kathleen without a crucial accessible bathroom in her high-rise apartment. Watch as the Holmes team transforms this concrete shell into a welcoming, wheelchair-friendly space.
Chloe, a synchronised swimmer, wants a mermaid-themed aquatic cake. Jane and Damion dive into her detailed, splashy design.
Jasmine, Martin, and Ambergré face off in a mystery round with jelly beans for a chance to compete in a Vegas-themed Donut Showdown. The last two standing compete for $10,000.

Team up with single-mom BFFs Karem and Sarah, who are searching for a home they can invest in together. Look around a resort-style spread with five bedrooms, a roomy waterfront house with 22-foot ceilings, and a cozy family home with stunning views.

Put on the glitz and join the quest for a high-end vacation home with luxury finishes. Lisa and her husband don't want a simple country getaway. They're looking for an opulent home where they can wine, dine, and wow their friends.

Step out of the comfort zone with Lynzie, who is asked to planning the most traditional wedding of her career for Lena and Matt. Feel the magic as she channels her inner princess and delivers the fairy-tale party that the couple has dreamed about.
In this episode Andrew is in Washington, D.C. where the finds are truly unique… including a rare Hot Wheels collection.

The guys follow one of the most amazing stories of ‘stuff' they've ever heard to discover 8 full trailers packed with goods. See deal making in action as Marty and Bam Bam make unique finds, from a vintage Italian motorcycle to a Model A Ford.

Welcome the shade in a cool gazebo built entirely from found wood. Join Colin as he harvests his own logs in a nearby forest to build a brilliant, low-cost alternative to an aluminum pop-up canopy on John's sun-kissed property.
